 FULL-TIME published at 90 + 5 mins 90 + 5 mins 
 Hamburger SV 3-1 Borussia M'gladbach 
 An exciting game right the way through tonight at the Volksparkstadion, with Hamburger coming out on top. For Borussia M'gladbach, they're going to have to really fight to stay in the league. It's their defence that's let them down today.
